why: Both are the state of the 'we' at Titus 3:3 (deceived/misled), each with the same us described_as edge; the Job 12:16 part of the kept record is its own matter and the duplicate adds nothing to it.

Gen 35:19 says 'Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem)' and Gen 35:16 names the same place on the same road; the Ephrath record has one edge and the Bethlehem record already carries Ephrath as alias and 'formerly called Ephrath'. Different Hebrew names, but the text itself equates them.
Both are Judah's Canaanite wife, 'the daughter of Shua' (Gen 38:2,12), mother of Er, Onan and Shelah (38:3-5), spouse of Judah; same mother_of and spouse_of edges.

'Tabernacles' is the Job 11:14/22:23 plural instance; 'tent' is the seeded word node for the lemma (Gen 9:21, Gen 12:8, Job 5:24...). A word node and one instance of its plural are not one recorded thing; doubt keeps them apart.

Same Berean section heading 'Jesus Predicts Peter's Denial', the same four tellings (Matt 26:31-35, Mark 14:27-31, Luke 22:31-38, John 13:36-38) and the same theme edges; only the trailing underscore in the id differs.
Different spans: Num 11:1-35 against Num 11:1-9, and the graph already records the smaller as part_of the larger. A sub-episode and the larger section are not one event recorded twice.
Different spans (Num 13:1-33 against 13:1-14:45, canonical against additional Copilot lists), already related part_of; the second carries the testing/failure/judgment template stages the first lacks.
Both are Job's unnamed wife who speaks at Job 2:9 ('Curse God and die'); same spouse_of edge to Job.
Same assessment at Titus 3:7, 'being justified by his grace', with the same us described_as edge; only the wording of the name differs.
Both are Elon the Hittite, father of Basemath, Esau's wife (Gen 26:34); both have father_of to bashemath_daughter_of_elon.

Gen 23:17 puts Ephron's field 'in Machpelah' and the cave in that field; the graph itself has the cave located_in the field. The cave, the field and the locality Machpelah are related but not one place; doubt keeps apart.

Gen 2:8 'the LORD God planted a garden in Eden'; the record 'the garden of Eden' (Gen 2:8, 3:23-24) and 'garden' (Gen 2:8) are the same planted garden, both with adam dwelt_at. The region Eden is a separate record (eden_region) and is not part of this pair.
Both are the place of Gen 13:18, 'the Oaks of Mamre' (KJV plain of Mamre) by Hebron, both located_in hebron_city; Abraham's dwelling there is the same event.
Job 1:18 'another messenger came' and 1:19 are one speech; the graph's own edge says the same messenger continues. The fourth messenger is one person.
Both are the unnamed man with an unclean spirit crying out in the Capernaum synagogue (Mark 1:23-26); the second adds the parallel Luke 4:33-35 for the same incident.
Both are the unnamed paralytic let down by four men to Jesus at Capernaum (Mark 2:3-12; Luke 5:18); both healed by Jesus.
Both are the formula at Titus 3:8, 'This is a faithful saying' / 'This saying is trustworthy', both described_as faithful.
Same obligation at Titus 3:2, 'to malign no one' (speak evil of no man); one has the edges, the other none.
Identical text of Paul's command at Titus 3:2 (malign no one, peaceable, gentle), both asserted_by Paul.

The same reign told in two books (2 Kgs 23:36-37 against 2 Chr 36:5-8) under separate Berean headings; the Chronicles telling adds Nebuchadnezzar binding him in bronze. Two tellings with differing detail are kept apart rather than merged blind.
Same assessment of 'these things' at Titus 3:8, 'excellent and profitable for the people' (good and profitable unto men); one edge each, differing only in subject id.
Identical text of Paul's instruction at Titus 3:12 (come to me at Nicopolis, winter there), both asserted_by Paul.

Both are 'to malign no one' at Titus 3:2, the same assessment. Part of a cluster of three with speak_evil_of_no_man_obligation and speaking_evil_of_no_man; the cluster keeper should be speak_evil_of_no_man_obligation, which holds the edges.
Both are the obligation to obey magistrates/rulers at Titus 3:1 ('to be obedient'); one verse, one demand.
Identical text of the reminder at Titus 3:1 (submit to rulers and authorities, be obedient, ready for every good work), both asserted_by Paul.

Same Titus 3:4 statement ('when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared'); one verse, same speaks_of targets. Cluster of three with titus_3_4_statement; keeper titus_3_4_claim.
Same Titus 3:4 statement, one verse, same speaks_of targets. Cluster of three with the_appearing_of_gods_kindness_and_love and titus_3_4_claim; keep the one with edges.
Identical text at Titus 3:4, both asserted_by Paul with the same speaks_of targets (God our Savior, kindness, man).

2 Kgs 12:21 names Jozabad (Ketiv Jozachar) son of Shimeath; 2 Chr 24:26 names Zabad son of Shimeath. Probably the same conspirator, but the original names differ and the verses are two tellings; doubt keeps apart.
Both are 'to malign no one' at Titus 3:2, the same assessment (cluster with not_speaking_evil and speaking_evil_of_no_man; keeper is the one with edges).
Both are 'fish of the sea' at Gen 1:26 and 1:28, with identical refs and identical speaks_of edges from the same two speeches.
Both are the act of rejecting a divisive man after a first and second admonition (Titus 3:10), each with the admonition condition.
